subject: Trade Brigade Newsletter Scans 💰 08/12/24

self_score.opener:
What a wild week, especially after the prior Friday's labor report swing and a miss... It just keeps getting better!

Since everyone's an expert in the Yen carry trade these days, I'll just give you my take briefly from a technical stand point.

The historical correlation between the S&P and the Yen

spy_levels.section: S&P weekly chart – A lower low has already been produced, and there was no higher low attempt. Now the watch is for a lower high to complete the trend change. The lower high makes sense here against 540ish HVN, VWAPs, two prior lows. Neutral to bearish.
spy_levels.sentence: The lower high makes sense here against 540ish HVN, VWAPs, two prior lows.

spy_levels.section: S&P daily chart – Lower highs being set here help the weekly thesis as well. Trend is clearly down. Gap fill reversal for a lower high is also a backtest of the neckline from the head and shoulders pattern. Bearish here with the only change in tone on a higher low over 539.5.
spy_levels.sentence: Bearish here with the only change in tone on a higher low over 539.5.

spy_levels.section: S&P hourly chart – Preferred path would look something like this with shorts having great R:R location near the A, B, C. In blue I'm highlighting that the move to test over 532.5 was not very explosive. If shorts were nervous, would have expected more emotion there.
spy_levels.sentence: In blue I'm highlighting that the move to test over 532.5 was not very explosive.

swing_ideas.text: Possible thin structure retrace over the 55.5 level. Great relative strength on Monday. Equal highs stacked, and looking for the break now. Only interested on a break above the level. Out of play if we make a move under Monday's open.
Bull flag forming with the opportunity for blue sky breakout. Over 82.6 and this has a shot at seeing continuation. Not interested under 80.
Bullish on chocolate! Looking for this inverted head and shoulders to continue here. Ideally this finds its way up to 210 prior swing high. In play as long as 200 flat holds.

Inverted head and shoulders. Looking for the neckline break over 45 flat for a continuation play into the prior flat top at 49. Needs to break the neck first, not jumping the gun, noting the daily / weekly down trend.

Thats all that hit the scanner this week qualified to be included in the newsletter.

Quality > Forcing setups
